prompt: Create an original 60 second acoustic swing jazz instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: acoustic guitar, violin, upright bass. Style: crisp rhythmic guitar and playful violin phrases. Tempo approximately 136 BPM; D major. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A lively and elegant string ensemble piece, featuring a prominent violin melody over a walking bass line and pizzicato accompaniment. The music has a traditional, almost folk-dance feel, with a clear structure and dynamic shifts.
description.zh: 一首活泼优雅的弦乐合奏曲，以小提琴为主旋律，配以行进的低音线和拨弦伴奏。音乐带有传统、近乎民间舞曲的感觉，结构清晰，富有动态变化。
